notes.title: Play the demo on Steam starting May 22!
notes.content:
[h2][b]May 22 - Our first official demo goes live![/b][/h2]
It is finally time for our first official demo release here on Steam and we hope that you're all excited to try Fall of Gorithia: Nym's Fate for the first time!

[previewyoutube=XGo1cQQjmmE;full][/previewyoutube]

We want to thank all of our playtesters for helping us make this demo as good as it can be. Without you there would be no demo at all.

Don't forget to follow our socials for all the latest news!

[url=https://discord.gg/u5jy9qMMQU]Discord[/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/nymsfate]Facebook[/url]
[url=https://x.com/NymsFate]X[/url]

Gorithia awaits - see you on May 22!

/Myrwood
